artist.mediums: Kerala mural painting, watercolour, coloured pencil, acrylic
artist.about: Mahi (Maheshwaran) paints in the Kerala mural tradition: Krishna, Ganesha, Shiva and the goddesses drawn in bold outline, filled with the style's ochre, red, green and blue, and framed with rich ornament and lotus borders. He also works in watercolour, coloured pencil and acrylic.
